Selection: 10 lowest SHA256(phase9-eval-v1/OracleId) per ordered stratum Damage, Modal, Other; Damage takes priority; exclude phase7/8 references/evaluation and three prior real examples. Not representative.
Labeling: Same developer, after parser/comparison/ranking freeze and before viewing baseline or current per-card predictions. No independent reviewer. Stratified, not representative. Removal includes targeted bounce/exile and potential creature damage; ordinary land mana, impulse access, combat and reanimation excluded.
